philippines.title: Memoirium is an indie Soulslike wonder made by a solo Filipino dev
philippines.description:
Paolo Villanueva started learning how to code and make games in 2020, during the pandemic, while looking for a career shift from freelance writing. Five years later, his solo project under GoldenGratus has become Memoirium, a Soulslike set inside a collapsing realm of dreams. The setting gives Villanueva room to put things together that would make little sense in a conventional fantasy world. A modern conservative school can exist beside a bright red castle made from sand and wax, while another area is an enormous version of the house where he grew up. “All these locations are based on my real-life […]...
